acceptance: A PR separate from sub-scale work contains the refresh code; CI is green and the review gate passes.
All 23 files per set are SHA-256 identical to bundled dsdgen at SF 0.01, 1, 10 and 100 (set 1) and SF 1 sets 2, 3 and 7, each run under make heavy-run with artifacts kept until merge.
`write_refresh('tpcds', ...)` is covered by Rust and Python tests with committed hashes; TPC-H `write_refresh` stays byte-identical to dbgen -U.

context: Owner decisions 2026-11-27 (dialog): (1) TPC-DS sub-scale: carry the 72-line tpcgen-rs #677 patch (pin tpcdsgen to a BenchBox-dev/tpcgen-rs commit = v4.0.0 + #677), delete own dsgen/ generators, return to crates.io when released. (2) Upstream-gap rule: no divergent fork; a carried patch only if <= ~200 changed lines, submitted upstream, pinned by commit, listed in README with its upstream PR; anything larger goes to the owner with sizes first. (3) TPC-DS refresh sets: keep own code in its own PR, finish SF 100 parity, offer upstream; required before C removal, not before the TPC cutover. (4) Acceptance: a metric passes inside legacy min-max or the 99.9% prediction interval from 5 legacy seeds; boundary quantiles on low-cardinality columns by rank. (5) Empty queries: must return rows on every seed where legacy does on every seed; where legacy is sometimes empty, the library may be empty on no more seeds than legacy. (6) SSB row counts follow the SSB specification (part = 200,000 x floor(1 + log2 SF), date = 2,556). (7) Oracle defects: qgen seed 0 for Q7/Q12 raises a clear error; the 13 nondeterministic dsqgen cases are excluded only with recorded proof and the library is deterministic for them. (8) Licensing: proceed; ship the TPC legal notice in wheels, templates and tpcds.idx stay in BenchBox, record the position in the licensing doc. (9) Until the review gate posts its first verdict, library PRs may merge with green CI plus an independent reviewer agent reporting no Critical/High/Medium findings; afterwards the gate is required. (10) BenchBox native-datagen extra may be developed and CI-tested against wheels built from a pinned library commit; the BenchBox PR adding the extra merges only after the PyPI release exists. (11) Lock-waiter kills: investigate and report only; no kill-policy change. Decision (3) keeps this code; the item is unblocked by the decision.
description:
## Problem
TPC-DS refresh sets (`dsdgen -update`) exist as own generators in `crates/benchbox-datagen-core/src/tpcds_update/` on draft PR #5, mixed with sub-scale work. Parity is proven at SF 1 (sets 1, 2, 3, 7), SF 0.01-0.5, SF 10 (set 1) and about 24 seeds, but SF 100 parity was never run under the heavy-work lock (a helper ran it without the lock and left no artifact). The code copies a dsdgen out-of-range calendar read (treated as 0), and dsdgen aborts at non-grid scales (SF 2, 3, 5), so those cannot be an oracle for the delete files. BenchBox uses refresh data in the TPC-DS maintenance test and QphDS.

## Change
If datagen-decision-upstream-gap-policy keeps own refresh code: move `tpcds_update/`, its tests and tools into their own PR; run SF 100 parity (all 23 files, set 1) under make heavy-run and commit the result hashes; document the calendar edge case and non-grid limitation in the README; open an upstream proposal for refresh-set generators and link it. If the decision is otherwise, remove the code and record the chosen path.

## Decision gates
- Blocked until datagen-decision-upstream-gap-policy is decided.
- If SF 100 parity fails, stop and report the differing file and first differing row; do not adjust the oracle.
- If upstream accepts refresh generators, plan deletion of ours in datagen-upstream-contributions-followup.

## Guardrails
- BenchBox work only in a linked worktree (make worktree-create, make agent-write-preflight); the primary clone is read-only.
- Heavy work only through make heavy-run; never bypass or signal the lock, and never kill processes by name pattern (pkill -f); stop only PIDs you started.
- Commits as the configured human identity; no agent attribution.
- No carried or own reimplementation of upstream code without the owner decision recorded in datagen-decision-upstream-gap-policy.
- A choice between a small and a large implementation path goes to the owner with sizes before work starts.
- Report only results that were observed; name anything not run.
